criteria.text: Given no configuration, When I commit on a protected branch, Then it is denied
Given branchProtection is ask, When I commit on or push to a protected branch, Then I am asked and may approve
Given branchProtection is off, When I commit on or push to a protected branch, Then the guard does not fire
Given the guard denies, When I read the message, Then it names the override
Given an invalid level, When I set it, Then it is refused and the previous value stands
Given a feature branch, When I commit at any level, Then the guard never fires
